best_for: Steel watch with a pink dial, listed for formal and casual occasions
verdict: A steel watch with a 26 mm case, a pink dial and a date window, listed with 50 m water resistance.
paragraphs: The store listing says the LTP-1241 models feature bright pastel colors for the face and a date indicator. This version has a pink dial, a stainless steel case and band, and a 26 mm case.
The listing gives the date at 3 o'clock, a mineral glass cover and 50 m water resistance. It lists the occasion as formal and casual.
The listing gives the strap colour as silver.
good: Date display at 3 o'clock, per the listing
Stainless steel case and band, per the listing
50 m water-resistance rating, per the listing
not_good: In our view, a 26 mm case is small
In our view, a pink dial will not suit everyone
The listing does not give the movement or the battery

sources.label: Casio India's authorised online store listing (casiostore.bhawar.com), LTP-1241D-4A
Casio support notice (support.casio.in): redirects to Casio's new authorized and exclusive online store
